title: Exercise 1: Multiple Choice Questions
instruction: Choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) that correctly applies verbs with prepositions or relative clauses referring to a whole sentence.
target_grammar: Verbs with prepositions, Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence

questions.text: The environmental committee decided to dispose ______ all obsolete electronic devices through an authorized recycling center.
questions.explanation: Động từ 'dispose' đi với giới từ 'of' (dispose of sth: vứt bỏ, xử lý rác thải đúng quy chuẩn).

questions.text: More suburban commuters have switched to public transport, ______ has contributed significantly to reducing air pollution in the city center.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ bổ nghĩa cho toàn bộ mệnh đề phía trước bắt buộc dùng ', which' (không dùng 'that', 'this' hay 'what').

questions.text: Our biology teacher urged all students to participate ______ the weekend campaign to clean up plastic litter along the riverbank.
questions.explanation: 'participate' đi với giới từ 'in' (participate in sth: tham gia vào hoạt động gì).

questions.text: The eco-club replaced disposable plastic cups with a reusable cup and glass jar, ______ helps minimize single-use packaging waste.
questions.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ 'which' đứng sau dấu phẩy thay thế cho cả sự việc thay thế cốc nhựa ở vế trước.

questions.text: Environmentalists warn that rising global temperatures directly result ______ the burning of fossil fuels and heavy greenhouse gas emissions.
questions.explanation: 'result from sth' mang nghĩa 'bắt nguồn từ, do cái gì gây ra' (nguyên nhân đứng sau 'from').

questions.text: Excessive accumulation of organic matter in landfills results ______ the production of hazardous methane and carbon dioxide.
questions.explanation: 'result in sth' mang nghĩa 'dẫn đến kết quả gì' (kết quả đứng sau 'in').

questions.text: The local youth organization succeeded ______ encouraging households to sort waste into each proper recycling bin.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'succeed in doing sth' (thành công trong việc làm gì).

questions.text: The industrial plant manager apologised ______ discharging untreated chemical pollutants into the municipal canal.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'apologise for doing sth' (xin lỗi vì đã làm điều gì).

questions.text: Many conscious teenagers truly care ______ adopting a sustainable zero waste lifestyle to protect natural resources.
questions.explanation: 'care about sth' mang nghĩa 'quan tâm, coi trọng điều gì'.

questions.text: All residents in the green village rely ______ clean green energy generated from community solar panels and wind turbines.
questions.explanation: 'rely on sth' mang nghĩa 'trông cậy, dựa vào nguồn gì'.

questions.text: Before dropping a takeaway container into the recycling bin, you should rinse ______ any oily leftovers to prevent contamination.
questions.explanation: Cụm động từ 'rinse out' có nghĩa là súc sạch, rửa sạch chất bẩn/thức ăn thừa bên trong hộp.

questions.text: The school cafeteria stopped providing single-use containers, ______ was warmly appreciated by eco-friendly students.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ bổ nghĩa cho toàn bộ sự việc ở mệnh đề trước phải dùng ', which'.

questions.text: Stricter regulations are required to protect marine wildlife ______ consuming toxic plastic debris drifting in the ocean.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'protect sb/sth from doing sth' (bảo vệ ai/cái gì khỏi nguy cơ gì).

questions.text: My family created a backyard compost pile, ______ allows us to turn each fruit peel and vegetable leftover into rich organic fertilizer.
questions.explanation: Dùng ', which' thay thế cho toàn bộ sự việc lập hố ủ phân ở mệnh đề trước.

questions.text: The park rangers took urgent precautions to prevent the devastating wildfire ______ spreading toward endangered animal habitats.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'prevent sth from doing sth' (ngăn chặn cái gì khỏi...).

questions.text: Installing a modern sensor tap and an automatic light across school buildings saves electricity and water, ______ is essential for green living.
questions.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ 'which' thay thế cho toàn bộ nội dung của mệnh đề phía trước.

questions.text: Sustainable farming models refuse to depend ______ artificial chemical fertiliser that depletes soil fertility.
questions.explanation: 'depend on sth' (phụ thuộc vào cái gì).

questions.text: Instead of buying bottled water, Minh carries a reusable bottle and refills it daily, ______ saves him considerable money in the long run.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề ', which' thay thế cho hành động mang bình nước và rót đầy nước mỗi ngày.

questions.text: The conservation committee strongly approved ______ the youth proposal to convert each cardboard box into a bird feeder and plant pot.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'approve of sth' mang nghĩa 'tán thành, ủng hộ việc gì'.

questions.text: Metropolitan cities are struggling to cope ______ hundreds of tons of solid household waste transported to landfills every day.
questions.explanation: 'cope with sth' nghĩa là 'đối phó, xoay xở xử lý vấn đề khó khăn gì'.
